memory_probe_source:
import cProfile,json,os,resource,sys,tempfile
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0,'scripts/performance')
import kv_read_profile as d
import alopex
mode=sys.argv[1];assert mode in ['none','per-call','continuous','python-only']
limit=512*1024*1024
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='alopex-712-profile-memory-') as tmp:
 db=alopex.Database.open(str(Path(tmp)/'tiny.alopex'))
 d.populate(db,alopex.TxnMode.READ_WRITE,3);db.flush();db.close();db=alopex.Database.open(str(Path(tmp)/'tiny.alopex'))
 requests=d.plans('begin-rollback',3,count=1)[0]
 def operation():return d.timed_operation(db,alopex.TxnMode.READ_ONLY,'begin-rollback',requests)
 def noop():return None
 profiler=cProfile.Profile();records=[]
 try:
  if mode=='continuous':profiler.enable()
  for i in range(1,1001):
   if mode=='per-call':profiler.runcall(operation)
   elif mode=='python-only':profiler.runcall(noop)
   else:operation()
   rss=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss
   if i in (1,10,100,1000) or rss>=limit:
    records.append(dict(batch=i,peak_rss_bytes=rss));print(json.dumps(dict(mode=mode,batch=i,peak_rss_bytes=rss)),flush=True)
   if rss>=limit:break
 finally:
  profiler.disable();db.close()
 print(json.dumps(dict(mode=mode,complete=i==1000,batches=i,profile_entries=len(profiler.getstats()),observations=records)),flush=True)
